label: Structured shared-IO feature process - deterministic reproduction of the high-direction base17 attention run through zero-based epoch 38 - persist next-1s direction by absolute-return decile - production59 primitive-consistent causal rollout - layer 8 causal self-attention Q256 K256 V256 O256 - K1 2x1s input x 59 - K2 2x1s primitive output x 17 rederived to 59 - W256 - M128 - P128 - F128 - PF256 - NF256 - standardized derived-feature MSE - 256k clean - batch 10240 train and evaluation - no regularization - weight EMA 4 epochs

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized number is one exact shared module reused at every matching block; layers other than 8 remain GNGLUs, while layer 8 is one shared causal self-attention module
architecture.initialState: the first observed W embedding seeds M and P with two unnumbered GNGLUs; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: shared layer 7 maps PF to NF; shared layer 8 causally self-attends over the generated NF-state prefix to emit expected W; shared layer 2 decodes W only to 17 primitive causal coordinates; differentiable fixed code reconstructs the complete future production59 state
architecture.baseConsistency: BTC one-second candle geometry, return activity, aggregate trade flow, aggressor side, spot volume, completed futures-minute state, and ETH minute return are decoded once; every affected production channel is derived from the same predicted primitive history
architecture.latentSemantics: P, F, PF, and NF remain unconstrained latent embeddings; no probability decoder or density loss is imposed

loss.description: decode only 17 primitive causal coordinates, differentiably reconstruct both complete 59-channel future states, then mean MSE over the two steps and all 59 channels after per-feature training-split standardization

sampling.description: the exact original production59 dense chronological nonzero-target population
sampling.comparisonControl: identical sample origins, K1/K2, latent widths, attention layer, optimizer, loss scope, examples, batches, EMA, and seed as the original base17 direct-output attention run; only the terminal epoch count and persisted direction audit differ

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.comparableMetrics: step-1 and per-step return metrics remain directly comparable to the original run
evaluation.directionAudit: equal-count deciles ordered by absolute target return with raw and magnitude-weighted direction accuracy, signed-return capture, MSE, and MSE skill

alignment.input: the same two consecutive production59 timeline rows ending at each control example origin
alignment.target: the same two complete chronological production59 rows at origin+1 and origin+2
alignment.causalDerivation: only predicted primitive coordinates and observed history through the input origin enter changing future channels; predicted step 1 updates rolling state before step 2; no observed future derived feature is consumed
alignment.attentionCausality: output step s attends only to generated NF states at output steps <= s
